assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Site boundary and key areas are based on provisional boundaries from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson. Official polygons will be released by the organizing committee.
assumptions.impact: All area calculations, land use proportions, and spatial metrics are provisional and will need recalculation when official boundaries are released.

assumptions.statement: Enterprise count, talent density, incubation rate, and visitor targets are aspirational design targets for the concept proposal, not verified commitments.
assumptions.impact: These metrics serve as evaluation indicators for the concept stage and require operational data to validate.

assumptions.statement: Building footprints, road alignments, green space boundaries, and public space polygons are conceptual design representations.
assumptions.impact: Detailed engineering surveys and official cadastral data are required before any implementation decision.

assumptions.statement: Implementation phases, project lists, and investment estimates are conceptual suggestions for professional team reference.
assumptions.impact: Official feasibility studies, budget approvals, and stakeholder consultations are required before implementation.
